name: Power BI
sku: Power BI Desktop and the Power BI service on a Pro licence. Capability that needs Premium Per User or a Premium or Fabric capacity is not scored here; Power BI as a Fabric workload is scored under Microsoft Fabric.

serve.bi-viz.note: Microsoft's business analytics platform. Power BI Desktop builds reports with more than 30 built-in and custom visuals, and the Power BI service publishes, shares, schedules refresh and collaborates. A Pro licence is needed to share with other Pro users.

serve.semantic-layer.note: Data models with relationships, DAX measures and calculated columns are published as semantic models that many reports share. The model lives inside Power BI rather than serving other tools.

bands.note: Power BI Desktop is the report-building environment, with data modelling, DAX, a performance analyzer, external tools and composite models.

Row-level security restricts rows per viewer with roles and DAX filters, including dynamic rules that use the signed-in user. It applies only to Viewers, not to workspace Admins, Members or Contributors, and cannot restrict columns.

Every workspace has a lineage view of its data sources, dataflows, semantic models, reports and dashboards, and their external dependencies. It needs a Pro licence and a Contributor role, and covers Power BI artifacts only.

proposed_capabilities.name: Visual self-service data preparation
proposed_capabilities.description: Point-and-click combining, cleaning and shaping of data (Power Query, dataflows) aimed at analysts, without writing SQL or Spark code. Dataflows Gen1 are in a legacy state, and Dataflow Gen2 is the recommended path on Fabric.

presentation.tagline: Desktop and cloud BI: reports, dashboards and shared semantic models.
